title: Tactix Hybrid
lines: QR-9 Hybrid - Our QR series of coverstocks are known for creating a strong footprint to the lane surface. A sanded version of this QR-9 Hybrid cover was first featured on the original Paradox.
Now, we are featuring this proven winner with a polished finish on our Starship core to create the Tactix Hybrid, providing easier length through the front part of the lane.
The asymmetry of the Starship core produces a medium mass bias strength, which provides an enhanced change of direction compared to symmetrical cores.
Finish | 500, 1000 Abralon® Polished with Power House Factory Finish Polish
